turns.message: I bought a Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 laptop for Rs. 28,990 on the PayTM Mall app on 17.06.2021. The delivery date was 24.06.2021 but the parcel came on 03.07.2021, and when it was opened in front of the delivery person it held a T-shirt with a Rs. 349 price tag instead of the laptop. The issue was raised with PayTM customer care with photographs. The company acknowledged it and promised refund initiation and a pickup on 10.07.2021, but the return request was then cancelled without explanation. I tried many times through PayTM's grievance redressal system, escalated to the National Consumer Helpline on 15.07.2021, visited the PayTM office in Chennai, and sent a legal notice dated 17.09.2021, which was ignored.

expected.rationale: The grievance route was attempted and is unresolved, but the verified corpus holds no accepted Consumer Commission route provision, so R6 cannot fire.
